restaurantIdentity.description: A traditional, unpretentious Egyptian Kababgy located in El Sawah (El Amerya, Cairo), specializing in flame-grilled meats, kofta, and authentic local meat dishes.

branches.name: El Sawah / El Amerya Branch
branches.address: El Sawah, El Amerya, Cairo, Egypt

sellingPoints: Authentic Egyptian local street-style charcoal-grilled meats
Generous portion sizes and traditional local presentation
differentiators: Deep local connection in the El Sawah/El Amerya working-class/residential area

brandIdentity.toneOfVoice: Warm, casual Egyptian Arabic (Baladi / Local), inviting and approachable.

officialBrandColors.name: brand-red
officialBrandColors.use: Logo oval, primary buttons, badges, links

officialBrandColors.name: brand-white
officialBrandColors.use: Logo type, button text, header bar

recommendedVisualDirection.style: Authentic Local Egyptian — match the official logo, not a generic fire/charcoal theme
recommendedVisualDirection.colorDirection: Official: bright crimson red, solid black, white. Page surfaces stay light so the red logo pops. Do not use orange ember as primary.
recommendedVisualDirection.typographyDirection: Bold Arabic (Cairo) for UI; logo artwork is never redrawn as web text.
recommendedVisualDirection.photographyDirection: High-contrast close-up grilled meats. Avoid Western fast-food and Pharaonic clichés.
avoid: Orange/ember palette that fights the red logo
Dark full-bleed headers that swallow the black logo border

assets.rule: If product/banner image is null or fails to load, the consumer MUST render the matching placeholder. Real photos replace files in docs/brand/assets/ without changing component API.
